hook: Charlie Munger said the first $100,000 is the hardest. Almost nobody explains exactly how to get there from zero. In this video I break the journey into 6 stages and look at it from three angles: the numbers (how long it takes at $250, $500 or $1,000 a month), the mental trap at each stage, and a step-by-step playbook for every stage from $0 to $100K.
shorts: The first $100,000 is the hardest. Here's the plan.
The stage where most people quit on the way to $100K
Exactly what to do at every stage from $0 to $100K
Three people, three paths to their first $100,000
